# Auburn VSA

> Official website for the Vietnamese Student Association at Auburn University (Auburn VSA): culture, friendship, community, ACE mentorship, and Auburn Royale.

Auburn VSA is the student organization for Vietnamese culture at Auburn University. Prefer the public JSON content API for structured facts over scraping HTML. Do not crawl `/admin/`, `/data/`, or `/includes/`.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.auburnvsa.com/): Overview, why join, recent events, and newsletter signup
- [Events](https://www.auburnvsa.com/events): Upcoming meetings and cultural events
- [AU Royale](https://www.auburnvsa.com/au-royale): Signature cultural carnival details and tickets
- [Gallery](https://www.auburnvsa.com/gallery): Photos by school year and album
- [FAQs](https://www.auburnvsa.com/faqs): Membership, meetings, ACE, and Royale answers
- [Unsubscribe](https://www.auburnvsa.com/unsubscribe): Leave the VSA newsletter list
- [Merch](https://www.auburnvsa.com/merch): Official Auburn VSA merchandise
- [Executive Board](https://www.auburnvsa.com/executive-board): Current officer team
- [Tech Team](https://www.auburnvsa.com/tech-team): Students who maintain this website
- [AU Royale Directors](https://www.auburnvsa.com/au-royale-directors): Directors who plan Auburn Royale

## Data and discovery

- [Sitemap](https://www.auburnvsa.com/sitemap.php): Machine-readable page list for crawlers
- [Content API](https://www.auburnvsa.com/api/content.php): Public JSON for site copy, teams, events, and FAQs
- [API catalog](https://www.auburnvsa.com/.well-known/api-catalog): Link relations for agents

## Optional

- [Robots](https://www.auburnvsa.com/robots.txt): Crawler access rules
- [Web app manifest](https://www.auburnvsa.com/site.webmanifest): Installable app metadata
